examples.question_text:
A pet survey records these numbers of students:

| Pet | Dog | Cat | Rabbit | Fish |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Students | 12 | 20 | 0 | 16 |

Draw a column graph with each vertical step representing $4$ students. Include a title, axis labels and all four categories.

methods.description: Use equal many-to-one scale intervals, convert counts to column heights, and construct labelled, equally wide and evenly spaced columns.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 4/Data Classification and Visualisation 2_Display data using graphical representations relevant to the purpose of the data.md lines 585–596, Worked Example: Construct and interpret column graphs

methods.description: Use the existing axis scale to add a missing column at its supplied count.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 4/Data Classification and Visualisation 2_Display data using graphical representations relevant to the purpose of the data.md lines 613–620, Column Graphs Foundation question 1

methods.description: Keep a zero-count category labelled on the axis with no visible column height.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 4/Data Classification and Visualisation 2_Display data using graphical representations relevant to the purpose of the data.md lines 778–780, Column Graphs question 12, image41.png: Mercury and Venus

methods.description: Place a column top exactly on the tick for a supplied labelled count, correcting a top incorrectly placed between ticks.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 4/Data Classification and Visualisation 2_Display data using graphical representations relevant to the purpose of the data.md lines 2188–2197, question 22(b), adapted column-height correction using the construction method at lines 588–596

methods.description: Compare column heights with supplied counts, identify a mismatch and correct the height using the axis scale.
methods.sourceRef: booklets/mathsmap-sources/Stage 4/Data Classification and Visualisation 2_Display data using graphical representations relevant to the purpose of the data.md lines 2188–2197, question 22(b)

coverage.summary: Removed only the unsupported title key from each of the three candidate examples. Preserved all question and solution text, diagrams, methods and mappings. Practice and quiz mathematics were unchanged and not re-audited. Rendered typography and layout verification remain for the capture stage.

examples.derivation: Independently calculated 12÷4=3, 20÷4=5, 0÷4=0 and 16÷4=4 steps. The solution columns have heights 3, 5, 0 and 4 with equal widths and gaps; Rabbit remains labelled without visible height. Construction follows lines 588–596; zero-count representation is supported by image41. The task remains within Stage 3 column-graph construction.

Adjacent axis labels differ by 5. Independently calculated 15÷5=3, 25÷5=5 and 20÷5=4 steps. The question shows only the two given columns; the solution adds Drama at height 4, reaching 20 and matching their width and spacing. Completing a partial graph follows lines 613–620 and image28.

Each step represents 6 books. Independently calculated required heights 18÷6=3, 30÷6=5 and 24÷6=4. The question draws heights 3, 4 and 3.5, representing 18, 24 and 21. Mystery needs one additional step; Fantasy needs half a step to reach 24. The solution draws the correct heights 3, 5 and 4. Height correction follows lines 2188–2197 and image137, with tick placement supported by the construction example.

review.summary: All 21 exact assessment locators are mapped once. The three examples cover construction with a supplied scale, missing-column completion, zero counts, mismatch correction and between-tick correction. Existing examples are empty. Questions and solutions remain separate; prose stays editable and inherits blue solution styling. No relation-led working requires a phantom gutter. Diagrams use black ordinary marks, unshaded columns and solution-only answer annotations. Final-size typography and layout remain for the capture stage. Practice and quiz mathematics were not re-audited.

Graph scales, column heights, zero frequency and corrections are correct. Labels and annotations are readable, with no consequential clipping or collisions. Question-only views hide all solution content.
